title.zh: Barrier厚度：太薄会漏，太厚会堵
title.en: Barrier thickness: too thin leaks; too thick obstructs

subtitle.zh: 真正要平衡的是连续性、阻挡能力、填充空间与导电截面
subtitle.en: Balance continuity, blocking capability, fill space and conductive cross-section

body.zh: 太薄；针孔；不连续 / 针孔；Barrier功能失守；Seed可能断裂
body.en: Too thin Pinhole Discontinuity / pinholes Loss of barrier function Possible seed breaks

body.zh: 合适窗口；侧壁与底部连续；孔口仍有填充空间；电阻与可靠性平衡
body.en: Suitable window Continuous sidewalls and bottom Fill space remains at the opening Balance resistance and reliability

body.zh: 太厚；Overhang；占用导电截面；孔口Overhang；Line / Via R上升
body.en: Too thick Overhang Occupies conductive cross-section Opening overhang Higher line / via R

body.zh: W Plug看什么；TiN；Ti；TiN太薄；W；Volcano /；反应风险
body.en: What to check for W plugs TiN Ti TiN too thin W Volcano / reaction risk
TiN Ti Liner too thick W Narrower W fill window

body.zh: Cu互连看什么；TaN；Ta；Cu Seed；TaN太薄；Cu扩散风险
body.en: What to check for Cu interconnects TaN Ta Cu seed TaN too thin Cu diffusion risk

body.zh: TaN；Ta；Cu Seed；Barrier /；Seed太厚；Cu截面变小、；R上升
body.en: TaN Ta Cu seed Barrier / seed too thick Smaller Cu cross-section, higher R

body.zh: 最容易被忽略：名义厚度 ≠ 孔底厚度；顶部厚度（t_top）；侧壁厚度（t_side）；孔底厚度（t_bottom）
body.en: Often overlooked: nominal thickness ≠ bottom thickness Top thickness (t_top) Sidewall thickness (t_side) Bottom thickness (t_bottom)

body.zh: Aspect Ratio越高，越要看Step Coverage与连续性
body.en: Higher aspect ratio requires closer attention to step coverage and continuity
Thickness Thickness Conformality Conformality Continuity Continuity

body.zh: 厚度不是单点答案，而是集成后的Process Window
body.en: Thickness is an integrated process window, not a single-point answer
